o: B. Record/report according to policy and accounting period, and escalate inappropriate pressure

o: C. Acknowledge the visitor, excuse yourself briefly and handle the call according to protocol

o: A. Verify and follow visitor/access procedure

o: B. Correct the error quickly, apologise briefly and redirect them

o: B. Do not disclose it without authority; take a message or use approved contact procedure

o: C. Promptly report and follow approved corrective/privacy procedure

fd.t: A visitor refuses to sign in. Best response?
